notes.title: Cronela´s Mansion Live on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[b]The kickstarter campaign for Cronela´s Mansion has already started! [/b]

You can visit the following link to check out the physical and digital editions compatible with Nes, Snes, Gbc, and Gba. as well as PC bix box editions.

CLASSIC DEMOS AVAILABLE! 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cronelasmansion/straynus

We are close to reaching our goal, but we still need your help.
If you can support me on Kickstarter or by sharing my campaign on your social networks, you will help me to be able to create all the classic versions.
Thank you very much!

STRAYNUS
